# Mowka
> Scouting Referral-Grade Talent for Top Startups. Transforming hiring from a bottleneck into a strategic growth lever.

## Summary
Mowka is an premium, practitioner-led talent sourcing partner. We operate as a high-conviction extension of a founder’s leadership team, delivering pre-vetted, referral-grade talent for AI-first companies and top-tier startups. We replace the "volume trap" of traditional agencies with a surgical focus on signal, technical depth, and cultural DNA.

- **What we do:** We handle the initial technical and cultural interviews. You only see candidates who have already passed our "Referral-Grade" bar.
- **The Metric:** We typically close roles within 1 to 5 introductions.
- **The Standard:** No noise, no volume traps. Just the right hire.

## Methodology
A focused, feedback-driven approach to finding the right person.
- Deep Context: We don’t just read a job description. We study your company, your culture, and the specific technical challenges of the role until we can represent your vision as clearly as you do. This ensures our search is aligned with your reality from day one.
- Expert Scouting: We find candidates by compounding a deep network of industry practitioners and former colleagues. This multiplier effect allows us to identify and interview referral-grade talent based on their actual track record and craft, rather than their visibility on job boards.
- Feedback & Refinement: We present one candidate at a time. If the first introduction isn't a perfect fit, we use your feedback to sharpen our search and improve our understanding. Each introduction brings us closer to the hire, usually finishing the search within 1 to 5 candidates.

## FAQs
Q: Why only one candidate at a time?
Traditional agencies create volume traps by sending dozens of uncalibrated profiles. We value your time. We do the heavy lifting of vetting candidates ourselves and only introduce the one who actually fits your needs.

Q: What happens if the first candidate isn't the right fit?
We use that interview as a data point. By listening to your specific feedback, we refine our search immediately. This sharpening process is why we are able to close most roles within just 1 to 5 introductions.

Q: How do you find candidates who aren't active on job boards?
We don't rely on static databases. We identify top-tier professionals on platforms like LinkedIn and extend our reach by compounding our network through them. When we find a high-quality person, we use that connection to branch out into their professional circles. This multiplier effect gives us access to a private tier of talent that traditional agencies often miss.

Q: What makes your technical screening unique?
Led by a former Amazon architect, we evaluate architectural trade-offs and behavioral DNA. Every candidate is calibrated against your unique environment, not just a keyword list.
